scope: New attribution of fixed actually requested legacy rho=.3 teacher views with new common frozen three-observation track features; no old prediction, belief or identity_vote reuse.
human_inspiration: Compare available visual evidence without treating correlated repeated looks as independent certainty; then enforce visual/semantic structural consistency.
not_tested: I1 new live acquisition policy, old vs new budget effect, or full deployment cost
shared_evidence: Every arm receives all actually requested view probabilities; same frozen teacher SHA, candidates, features, normalization prefix, weight recipe, compute schedule and independent >.5 decoder.
temporal_scope: Current video transductive; source feature normalization, head data, DS estimation and appearance calibration use only past/current video prefix; past predictions sealed and never revised.

fusion.repeated_calls: Mean probability per query/TrackID/effective view; may have different frame anchors, not exact duplicate/cost savings.
fusion.raw_mean: Arithmetic probability mean of present views; unrequested views remain missing.
fusion.binary_votes: Per-view mean >.5; Beta(8,2) sensitivity/specificity prior, 20 EM iterations, fitted prevalence used only internally.
fusion.learned_target: expit(mean observed per-view log likelihood ratio), neutral prior, clip [.02,.98]; regularized evidence, not raw DS posterior.
fusion.identifiability: If fewer than 2 active views or no overlapping cells, DS targets equal fixed targets. Correlated two-view or sparse triple overlap does not identify true annotator accuracies.
fusion.absent_or_future_QA: Never filled from SQLite or future videos.

training.head: 768 ->64 GELU ->1
training.source_residual: Zero except additional ordinary RAW_SRC_FINAL: fixed source logit clipped [-2,2].
labels: RAW_SRC soft mean with source residual
training.fitting: Existing AdamW lr=.001 wd=.001 batch512, min4000 max16000, teacher KL<=.005; final canonical, raw early/final mean also reported.

postprocessing: Same protocol-conditioned scene pooling, teacher-prefix PAVA and conservative text implication convex projection for RAW/FIXED/DS full variants.
controls: Learned vs fixed reliability, learned vs raw probability, structure conditional on DS, context/visual/implication removals, deterministic shuffled implication graph, reliability x structure point interaction.
quantity: DS_FULL compared with every ordinary baseline at both per-query/per-frame predicted counts. Thirteen count variants including all self-count consistency checks.
GT_barrier: All 18 conditions and all 468 raw/count outputs sealed before isolated official evaluator reads this study GT.
interpretation: All available datasets DEV; parent/seed intervals descriptive, not held-out confirmation. KITTI 4 parent videos: no population CI. No result promoted post hoc.
physical_scope: Only GPU0/1/2/3, wait current transfer GPU stage release then internal <512MiB preflight. Zero new teacher/encoder calls; replay wall is not deployment cost.
